name: 书剑天下（小熊泥苑分站）
english_name: Book and Sword Under Heaven (Little Bear Branch)
english_description: Self-titled "Book and Sword Under Heaven," this is a branch deployed by the "Little Bear Mud Garden" (dtxy.126.com) site. Its source is confirmed nearly identical to shujian2008's elsewhere in this collection — only 32 of 11,737 shared-path files differ, almost all bugfix/log/save churn rather than content — two independent deployments of the same underlying game. Like shujian2008, it spans a Jin-Yong-flavored map (Shaolin, Wudang, Emei, Kunlun, Mingjiao, the Xingxiu Sect, the Five Mountain sword schools, the Ancient Tomb) laid over real-world city names from Chang'an to Suzhou; new characters begin at a martial-arts-hall front courtyard, roll attribute talents, and formally apprentice into one of these sects. Chinese-name registration blocks actual Jin Yong character names outright, and the game layers SMS/short-message and VIP subscriber features on top of the standard wuxia stat/sect/cultivation core.
